source_full_audit_binding.reason: The meta-registry stores a normalized projection with exact active-front and PR-head data; the larger source audit is bound by digest and reproducible from the public repository.

load_bearing_findings: The active repository state is a stacked multi-branch PR graph, not one merged main-branch tree.
The requested root ACTIVE_PROOF_ROUTE_MATRIX.md was not found; the active matrix was located under docs/ on the top stacked branch.

C049.1 B4.2 certifies only the charged 3k grouped scaffold; node full sets, complete branch refinement, reconstruction completeness, replayable empty-root NO_LAYOUT_AT_CAP, and final C047 composition remain open.
C043 and C044 are not frozen: C043 remains pending final admission review and C044 is canonical, implemented, CI-green, draft, and review-pending.
No repository artifact resolves P versus NP; the global status remains OPEN.
method_boundary: The audit aggregates GitHub metadata and file inventories across open Draft PR heads and research branches.
It is not a byte-for-byte tree walk of one ref because no single ref contains the full stacked research state.
Unavailable digests, timestamps, workflow results, or freeze states are marked absent, not found, not extracted, branch-dependent, or unclassified.
CI success is evidence that registered executable checks passed; it is not mathematical admission of the associated theorem.
This capsule does not promote OPEN to SAT, UNSAT, hardness, P=NP, or P!=NP.
